events.label: Kimi K3 full open-weight model release — 2.8T parameter model; second AI efficiency wave
events.note: Moonshot AI releases full Kimi K3 model weights (2.8 trillion parameters) publicly on July 27. Context has shifted significantly: INTC Q2 beat (DC+AI +59%, $16.1B revenue) and AMD's confirmed hyperscaler sweep (all four major hyperscalers) reduce the likelihood that Kimi K3 efficiency arguments dominate. However, GOOGL's -7% on capex concerns and Brent $100 have put the market in risk-off posture entering Monday — open-weight inference-efficiency models (Kimi K3 at 70% pricing discount vs. API providers) still directly challenge the hyperscaler inference-capex ROI thesis. The AMD keynote 'sell the news' dynamic (-3.85% despite confirmed hyperscaler wins) suggests the market may respond similarly to any AI efficiency narrative that complicates the infrastructure-demand story. Do not add NVDA or AMD into July 27 — the open-weight release is binary event risk on any GPU-exposed position.

events.label: FOMC meeting (Jul 28-29) — September hike 82%; markets pricing non-trivial July hike probability
events.note: As of July 23 close: July hold still expected (95%+) but Forbes reporting markets now price non-trivial July hike probability. September hike probability reached 82% after Brent crude crossed $100 for the first time since May 26 and 10Y Treasury yield topped 4.7% (highest since January 2025). FOMC enters with Brent $100.69 / WTI $92.19, 30Y at 5.188%, and SPX 28 points from the formal BEARISH conversion threshold at 7,380. The September language in the FOMC statement is now the single most market-moving variable of the year: dovish September language (characterize Brent $100 as transitory) = September hike probability collapses toward 45-55%, IWM/TLT relief; hawkish September language (acknowledge oil embedding in CPI) = September hike probability jumps to 90%+, formal BEARISH regime activation likely via SPX below 7,380. The FOMC must adjudicate whether Brent $100 oil is transitory (as it was in 2022 post-Ukraine) or structurally embedding from a multi-year Iran conflict — that distinction moves all assets for the balance of 2026.

events.label: FOMC Rate Decision + META Q2 + MSFT Q2 + AMZN Q2 — peak Q2 season density
events.note: FOMC rate decision (2pm ET) plus three Magnificent Seven earnings after close. Context as of July 23: GOOGL fell -7% on capex concerns ($195-205B, 2027 increase committed); META, MSFT, and AMZN now face the same capex-ROI scrutiny. META Q2 (first to quantify Bloomberg-reported AI cloud-to-third-parties business) is the key. MSFT Azure must validate AMD Helios anchor-customer narrative with actual AI revenue growth. AMZN AWS is the third hyperscaler AI demand read after GOOGL (82%) and INTC enterprise DC+AI (+59%). GOOGL's experience suggests that even massive AI demand beats are overridden by capex concerns — META and MSFT must show credible capex ROI to avoid the same fate. If FOMC is dovish AND all three Mag-7 beats AI demand thesis, this is the single session that can reopen the upgrade cycle from its current zero-reset. If FOMC hawkish + any two disappointments, SPX tests 7,280-7,320 range.

events.label: July CPI (est.) — WTI $92.19 + Brent $100.69 embedding; September hike at 82%
events.note: July CPI is the first release to fully capture WTI at $92.19 and Brent at $100.69 — the new conflict-phase highs as of July 23. September hike probability at 82% means a CPI print above 3.5% YoY would make September near-certain (90%+ probability). Gasoline prices follow Brent with a 2-3 week lag, so the July 23 $100 Brent crossing fully embeds in the August CPI gasoline component. The August 13 CPI print is the clearing event that determines whether the September hike is 25bps (inflation moderating despite oil) or 50bps (inflation re-accelerating on energy pass-through). Bull scenario (July CPI ≤3.2% YoY with oil-shock not embedding in core): September hike probability collapses below 50%, rate-relief regime opens. Bear scenario (July CPI ≥3.5% YoY): September 50bps probability approaches 90%, BEARISH regime confirmed through Q4.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — must address AMD hyperscaler sweep + Kimi K3 + TSMC wafer hike
events.note: NVDA Q2 FY27 is the fundamental clearing event for the AI GPU thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. Context updated July 23: (1) AMD keynote confirmed all four major hyperscalers (OpenAI, Meta, MSFT Azure, Oracle, Anthropic 2GW) as Helios customers — the most credible competitive diversification from Nvidia in the AI cycle's history; (2) INTC Q2 Data Center +59% shows enterprise AI demand is broad-based, reducing single-vendor concentration risk; (3) Kimi K3 full open weights released July 27 — demand impact must be quantified; (4) TSMC wafer hike unresolved; (5) Brent $100 and September hike at 82% create macro headwinds for growth multiples. Hard stop $195 intact; do not add until Q2 FY27 addresses all five factors with data.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. Re-entry gate $115-120 for risk-tolerant 12-month investors. Net losses structural ($4.9B in 2025). December 2026 lock-up expiry adds supply overhang. Watch Starlink ARR growth and Starship launch cadence as primary metrics.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst.
